evidence: Modifies src/torcontrol.cpp, which implements the Tor integration covered under P2P.
rationale: Fixes a v32 logging regression that unconditionally outputs warnings for Tor control port failures on default nodes. As noted in the description, 'this pollutes debug.log with approximately 18 warning lines every hour' when a Tor daemon is not running, providing clear quality-of-life value to node operators without affecting P2P transport correctness or network security.
